subscription.contact: To renew or change plan, please contact your provider.

settings.taxIdHint: 13 digits; may be left empty until it is needed
settings.branchHint: For example: Head office, or Branch 00001

vatModeHints.None: No VAT is charged or shown on bills
vatModeHints.Inclusive: Customers pay the shelf price; the VAT is worked out of what they pay
vatModeHints.Exclusive: VAT is added to the item prices after discounts

settings.vatNotice: A change here applies to new bills only; existing bills keep their amounts. Please confirm with the shop's accountant whether the shop must register for VAT. The system does not issue tax invoices yet.
settings.pointsExample: A purchase of 1,000 baht earns {{points}} points
settings.pointsRules: A customer earns points when their name is chosen at the till, on what they actually pay after discounts and points used. A part of a point is not given. A discount from points comes off before VAT, needs the till to be online, and must leave something to pay. When a bill is cancelled, the points it gave are taken back and the points used on it are returned.
settings.pointValueOff: 0 = points cannot be used as a discount

pos.usePointsOffline: Points cannot be used while offline
pos.pointsNeedServer: A bill that uses points needs a connection. Try again, or remove the points and sell.

offline.localResults: Results from this device. Stock levels may be out of date.
offline.savedMessage: The server cannot be reached right now. This sale will be sent automatically when the connection returns.
offline.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting to be sent
offline.willSyncLater: Sales are sent automatically when the connection returns
offline.syncRefused_one: The server did not accept {{count}} sale. Please review it.
offline.syncRefused_other: The server did not accept {{count}} sales. Please review them.
offline.discardConfirm: This sale will not be recorded anywhere and cannot be recovered. Discard it?
offline.catalogNeverSynced: This device has never downloaded the product list. Open the till once while online first.
offline.staleWarning: Some sales have been waiting for more than {{hours}} hours. Connect to the internet to send them, or export them to a file first.
offline.staleToast_one: {{count}} sale has been waiting on this device for more than a day. Please check.
offline.staleToast_other: {{count}} sales have been waiting on this device for more than a day. Please check.
offline.notProtected: This browser does not promise to keep these sales. Do not clear the site's data, and keep an exported file until they are sent.
offline.logoutTitle: Some sales have not been sent
offline.logoutWarning_one: {{count}} sale has not reached the server. It stays on this device and is sent when a user of this shop signs in here again. If the browser's data is cleared before then, it is lost.
offline.logoutWarning_other: {{count}} sales have not reached the server. They stay on this device and are sent when a user of this shop signs in here again. If the browser's data is cleared before then, they are lost.

push.turnOn: Turn on notifications on this device
push.turnOff: Turn off notifications on this device
push.enabled: Notifications are on. This device will be told when stock runs low.
push.disabled: Notifications are off on this device
push.blocked: The browser is blocking notifications for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.

reports.cut: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rows. Download the file to see them all.
reports.note: Completed bills only. Amounts by item and category are after line discounts, before bill discounts and points, so they may not add up to net sales.
reports.profitNote: Gross profit = sales without VAT and after every discount, less the cost of the goods when they were sold. The shop's other expenses are not taken off.
reports.withoutCost: Sales of {{amount}} in this period are from bills made before costs were recorded, so they are in neither the cost nor the gross profit.

import.title: Import items from a file
import.intro: Use an .xlsx or .csv file with the column names on the first row. SKU, name and price are needed. A new SKU becomes an item. An existing SKU has its details replaced by the file, but its stock is not changed.
import.failed: The file could not be imported. Try again.
import.updateNote: Existing items get the details in the file. Their stock is not changed.
import.stockNotChanged: {{rows}} rows have a quantity that differs from the stock on hand. An import does not change the stock of an existing item: correct it on the item itself.
import.noErrors: No problems found. Nothing is saved until you press Import.
import.hasErrors: {{errors}} problems found. Fix the file and choose it again. No item has been saved.
